title: Gradient Descent & Linear Algebra Visualizer
description: Implement gradient descent on simple loss surfaces and an interactive visualization of vectors, matrices, and optimization trajectories, then validate numerics with tests against analytic results.
learningObjectives: Implement vector and matrix operations without a linear-algebra library
Derive and code gradients for quadratic and logistic losses
Explain learning-rate effects with visual evidence
Verify numerical gradients with finite differences

milestones.title: Vector & matrix ops from scratch
milestones.objective: Implement dot products, matmul, transpose, and norms in a plain NumPy-free core.
milestones.expectedOutput: Tested linear-algebra module with property checks.

milestones.title: Gradient descent variants
milestones.objective: Implement batch, mini-batch, and stochastic updates on quadratic and logistic losses.
milestones.expectedOutput: Convergence histories recorded per variant and learning rate.

milestones.title: Interactive visualization
milestones.objective: Plot contour maps with animated optimizer trajectories; expose learning-rate and batch-size controls.
milestones.expectedOutput: Readable notebook animation or small web app.

milestones.title: Numerical validation
milestones.objective: Check analytic gradients against finite differences; document maximum relative error.
milestones.expectedOutput: Tests asserting gradient correctness within tolerance.

categories.minimumExpectation: Descent reduces loss monotonically for a small fixed learning rate
categories.excellentExpectation: All variants work with configurable rate and momentum plus edge-case tests
Walkthrough links each equation to its code location

criteria: Unit tests for ops and optimizers
